findings.summary: teacher.js sets $('ct-day-week').value = 1 and $('ct-day-of-week').value = 0 imperatively, bypassing x-model reactivity. Alpine's week/day data stays at string defaults. No Alpine expression currently reads this state so no visible bug exists, but any future Alpine binding on this component will silently read stale initial values.
findings.action: Remove the imperative .value = assignments and rely on x-data defaults matching the <option> defaults, or add @change="drawDay()" in HTML and remove .onchange = drawDay from teacher.js.
